Karnataka Ambulance Staff Defer Strike After Assurances

Staff of Karnataka's 108 ambulance service have deferred a planned strike after receiving assurances. The staff had been seeking written assurances regarding their demands. Reports indicate the staff had threatened a mass exit if their demands were not met, with one outlet quoting them as saying, 'Pay Us Or We Quit'.
